text:
Nora: customer confusion—copy icon copies JSON, they expected CSV.
Diego: oof. Tooltip just says 'copy'.
Sam: propose primary 'Copy CSV' button + overflow 'Copy JSON'.
Priya: avoid long-press. keyboard users need explicit menu items + aria-labels.
a11y-bot: use full label 'Copy table as CSV'; announce 'Copied N rows' via aria-live.
Nora: also truncate text to 200 chars in CSV, column name 'text_snippet' to avoid leaking full content.
Sam: backend: add csv_truncate flag. frontend call example: /export?format=csv&truncate=true
Diego: placement: keep export in right actions cluster, collapse to kebab on mobile.
Priya: icon contrast is low—use darker gray for AA compliance.
Nora: I'll write microcopy and a small mock. Sam + Diego will split impl.
Sam: opening PR later today, will tag Priya for a11y review.
Diego: prototyping kebab + overflow menu now.
Nora: thanks all :thumbsup:
